herb_attributes.dosage: Internal: 3–15 g; External: appropriate amount (fresh pounded and applied; decoction for washing; powder for sprinkling; ointment)
herb_attributes.preparation_method: decoct as a decoction, grind to powder, make into instant powder; fresh material pounded for topical use; decoction for washing; roast and grind for powder
herb_attributes.contraindications: Use with caution in those with spleen and stomach deficiency-cold
